Definition: the simpler form of G1698; to me:--I, me, mine, my.
BiblicalUsage: Moi is the plain word for 'to me', the unaccented form of the pronoun — Herod says 'bring me word again', and Jesus says not everyone who says to me 'Lord, Lord' will enter the kingdom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little word carries the whole question of the Gospels: what is said to me, and what is done about it.
